build_GLIP_detector: build a GLIP grounded language-image perception detector with backbone, neck, bbox_head, and language_model configs
run_ner_on_caption: run named entity recognition on a caption string to extract noun phrases and their token positions
create_positive_map: create a positive map tensor mapping bounding boxes to associated text tokens for grounded detection
get_tokens_and_prompts: get tokenized text, caption string, tokens positive, and entities from a caption or custom entity list
predict_GLIP: predict detection results from input images with text prompts using the GLIP model with optional custom entities
